statement: A valuation based on a formula that, if used as part of a nonlapse restriction, would be considered fair market value under Treas. Reg. § 1.83-5 is presumed reasonable, provided the stock is valued in the same manner for purposes of any transfer to the issuer or to a person owning more than 10 percent of the voting power, other than an arm's-length sale of substantially all of the corporation's stock.
caveat: Summary of Treas. Reg. § 1.409A-1(b)(5)(iv)(B)(2)(ii); rebuttable on a showing of gross unreasonableness, and the § 1.83-5 nonlapse-restriction standard and the consistency condition are legal questions for counsel. Check the regulation text and current codification.
